messages:
maria-r: Quick sync — GCP TPU v5 marketplace preview. NDA is signed (legal confirmed), partner can provision preview pods next week. Need to align on: benchmarks we publish, marketplace packaging (trial image + billing test), and a joint announcement embargo window. Looping in eng/product/devrel.

gcp-rep: Thanks Maria — correct on NDA. We can give you two v5 pods (internal name: tpu-v5-pod-2) for a 2-week preview. Marketplace reqs: a 30-day trial image, a pricing test flow (billing token), and a small HOWTO for customers. We can support a staging listing first.

oliver-k: Got it. I'll spin up the pods and run our standard perf suite. Can someone drop the representative prompt sets and target SLAs? Also need keys/traffic generator.

sasha-p: For marketing, target benchmarks we show: token throughput and 99p latency for chat. Product preference: show 99p < 250ms for 512-token chat, and embedding p50 < 12ms. Those numbers are flexible but they'd be compelling.

derek-s: I'll build the test image and the billing test harness. Quick note on packaging: marketplace wants a single OCI image + a README with start args. I can adapt our dev image.

oliver-k: ETA — I'll have baseline runs by Wed (3 days). Plan: run regen bench (70/30 chat/complete) and embeddings workload. Example run command I used locally:

```bash
./run_bench --model rwi-tpu-v5 --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --duration 120 --prometheus 
```

oliver-k: Will post the raw numbers and the flamegraph. If we see kv-cache hot paths, we'll try reduced context tests.

gcp-rep: On billing test — we provide a test token that simulates a customer purchase flow. Also FYI legal prefers a 2-week embargo after the public listing for joint press.

sasha-p: Are we aiming for a joint press release or a co-marketing blog? I prefer a soft joint blog first, then PR depending on early feedback.

maria-r: Soft blog sounds good. Let's aim to ship the staging listing next Friday and decide on announcement after 10 days of preview data. Owners: oliver = eng lead for perf, derek = packaging/image, sasha = announcement lead, maria = partner comms.

oliver-k: Noted. Two questions: 1) Do we get network egress limits on the pods? 2) Any constraints on custom kernels/privileged containers?

gcp-rep: 1) Pods have default egress allowance but we'll put a quota for the preview — should be fine for benchmarking. 2) No privileged containers on marketplace images; we can allow specific capabilities through our runtime if needed but prefer non-privileged.

derek-s: OK, will keep image unprivileged and use sidecar for env creds. Also will include a small smoke test that hits the billing token.

sasha-p: Timeline check: benchmarks by Wed, staging listing by next Fri, 10 days preview data, then decide blog + learnings. If any numbers are off, we hold announcement.

maria-r: Action items captured: oliver -> perf runs + logs (due Wed), derek -> staging OCI + billing test + README (due Thu), sasha -> draft blog outline + coop quotes request (due Thu), maria -> coordinate partner comms + embargo language. I'll set a 30-min sync Tue to unblock.

gcp-rep: Sounds good. I'll provision the pods Mon morning and send access details to derek and oliver. Also attaching partner contact for legal for embargo sign-off.

oliver-k: Great. One last ask — can partner enable Prometheus scrape on the pods? makes perf correlation easier.

gcp-rep: Yes, we can enable a scrape endpoint on the staging pods. We'll share credentials out-of-band.

maria-r: Perfect. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll follow up with calendar invites and a doc with the checklist.

sasha-p: +1, thanks team :sparkles:
